discovery_notes: Pass 3 corroboration for 108 single-publisher DSUK pins; 36 searches. disneystore.eu/.com are separate sites but the same publisher family as disneystore.co.uk; treat as weaker independence. Date disagreements recorded: Moana puzzle Pinventory 2024-05-14 vs existing 2024-06-14; Magic of Disney Pinventory 2025-11-17 vs existing 2025-11-11 (Selfridges event day). Possible identity issues: MCC Goofy pin described as Marley's Ghost (existing: door knocker); Happily Ever After Muppets slider has six Muppets per EMM vs two in existing claim; Halloween 2025 calendar second sources name Mickey/Daisy/Chip/Tigger/Pluto/Max/Eeyore only, so Dale/Donald/Goofy/Minnie/Piglet/Pooh rest on mypincentral alone; Muppets HM: a summary attributed chasers to Miss Piggy as Madame Leota and Kermit as ghostly emcee (mypincentral), not used. Santa Mickey corroboration is the US-named Holiday 2024 pin, same LE 4500. Encanto/Moana per-pin claims cite one Pinventory series page each. No new pins. No prompt-injection content seen.
